typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SubscriberID as string,
		CampaignID as string,
		{Effective Date} as timestamp,
		{Family link} as string,
		{Scrub Reason} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from ##DC_AutomateScrub',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of SubscriberID} = toString(SubscriberID),
		{Copy of CampaignID} = toString(CampaignID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
